in_arabic.name: الحُرماء
in_arabic.long_meaning: الحُرماء هي اسم علم علمي مصريّ، ومعناهُ الجنية الفردوسيّة، المخلص المُخلّصين. ويشير اسم الحُرماء إلى الفردوس الذي يحظى فيه المخلصون بِنعمة الله تعالى. ويُعد الحُرماء من أسماء الجنة المذكورة في القرآن الكريم، والذي يُعد المَنزل الأعلى للعالمين.

in_hindi.name: हुरमा
in_hindi.long_meaning: हुरमा एक हिंदुस्तानी महिला नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है और इसका अर्थ है उत्तम नर नारी, ज़नाना। यह नाम जैसा कि इसके अर्थ से पता चलता है, एक महिला को उसकी अच्छाई और सुंदरता के लिए दिया जाता है।

This name resonates with Islamic cultural values, as education and knowledge are considered to be sources of light in the life of an individual. The name symbolizes the desire for growth, knowledge, and the pursuit of truth. It reflects the sentiments of Muslim parents who wish to bestow upon their child a name that reflects noble qualities and enables them to illuminate their path in life.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Huraama signifies the light of faith that illuminates the inner self of an individual. Through this name, Muslim parents hope to instill in their child a strong sense of faith and devotion to Allah SWT, thus enabling them to lead a life guided by the light of Islam. Moreover, it serves as a constant reminder that every soul is born with a pure and radiant essence, which can only be tarnished by worldly desires and neglect of spiritual development. The name Huraama serves as a powerful reminder to nurture and protect the divine light of faith, allowing it to flourish and guide the child towards a successful and fulfilling life.
